Description
Dedicated to providing its students with lifelong employability skills, the University of Stirling prepares its students for their future career. Our programs lead to a tailored degree at Stirling, where students receive a world-class education on a campus that welcomes the world. QS 5-Stars Excellence Award for teaching, employability, internationalisation, research, facilities and inclusiveness (QS World University Rankings 2021).500+ course options, including single CAS programs that require one visa for your students' full studies.Scotland is home to two of the UK’s top three student cities (QS Best Student Cities 2022), with easy access to other popular European destinations.100% overall student satisfaction (INTO Annual Student Experience Survey 2022).100% of students agree that their course has been worth the investment of time (INTO Annual Student Experience Survey 2022).
